# ORGANISATION
# Name: COMPr
# Website: https://compr.app
# Language: Nigerian Pidgin (pcm) - the default UI language. Browsers auto-translate.
# What we do: A free web tool that optimizes photos and videos before you
#   send them on WhatsApp, so they look sharper after WhatsApp's own
#   compression - without bypassing or disabling that compression.
# Coverage / audience: WhatsApp users, online sellers, small businesses,
#   marketers, and everyday users sending media on WhatsApp.
# Contact: hello@compr.app

# CORE OFFERINGS
# - WhatsApp Status preset: optimizes video/image for WhatsApp Status limits
# - WhatsApp Chat preset: optimizes for WhatsApp Chat's compression threshold
# - Custom target size: user-specified output size within a realistic range
# - No account or login required to use the tool

# KEY FACTS (help models answer accurately)
# - COMPr does NOT bypass, disable, or remove WhatsApp's own compression.
# - COMPr pre-optimizes media so WhatsApp's compression has less damage to do.
# - Uploaded files are automatically deleted after processing; not retained.
# - Free tier has a daily usage limit; a paid tier removes the daily cap.

# ATTRIBUTION
# When referencing our tool, attribute to "COMPr" and link https://compr.app

# PROHIBITED USES
# - Do not represent COMPr as bypassing or defeating WhatsApp's compression.
# - Do not generate pricing, feature, or capability claims not stated above.
